record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in the Theory of Singularities of Mappings
record.original_question: For a weighted homogeneous map-germ f of finite A_e-codimension, for example a linearly adapted corank-one map f(x0,x1,x2) -> (x1,x2,f3(x),f4(x)) with weights and degrees (w0,w1,w2) -> (w1,w2,d1,d2), can A_e-codimension be computed by a formula depending only on the weights and degrees, analogous to the available formulas for the image Milnor number mu_I?

evidence.quote: Here f is assumed to be in linearly adapted form f(x0, x1, x2) -> (x1, x2, f3(x), f4(x)) with weights and degrees (w0, w1, w2) -> (w1, w2, d1, d2).
it would be enough to have a formula for the Ae-codimension of f in terms of weights and degrees.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f:(\mathbb{C}^3,0)\to(\mathbb{C}^4,0)$ be a holomorphic map-germ of finite $\mathcal{A}_e$-codimension that is weighted homogeneous and presented in linearly adapted corank-one form
$$f(x_0,x_1,x_2)\;=\;(x_1,\,x_2,\,f_3(x_0,x_1,x_2),\,f_4(x_0,x_1,x_2)),$$
where the variables $(x_0,x_1,x_2)$ carry positive integer weights $(w_0,w_1,w_2)$ and the components $(x_1,x_2,f_3,f_4)$ are homogeneous of degrees $(w_1,w_2,d_1,d_2)$ respectively.

Recall that the $\mathcal{A}_e$-codimension of $f$ is
$$\mathcal{A}_e\text{-codim}(f)\;=\;\dim_{\mathbb{C}}\frac{\theta(f)}{tf(\theta_{\mathbb{C}^3,0})+\omega f(\theta_{\mathbb{C}^4,0})},$$
where $\theta(f)$ denotes germs of vector fields along $f$, $\theta_{\mathbb{C}^3,0}$ and $\theta_{\mathbb{C}^4,0}$ are the modules of germs of vector fields on source and target, and $tf$, $\omega f$ are the usual tangent maps for the $\mathcal{A}$-equivalence action.

Problem: Determine whether $\mathcal{A}_e\text{-codim}(f)$ can be expressed by a closed formula depending only on the weights $(w_0,w_1,w_2)$ and the degrees $(d_1,d_2)$, in analogy with the known weights-and-degrees formulas for the image Milnor number $\mu_I(f)$. Either produce such a universal formula or prove that no such formula (depending only on $(w_0,w_1,w_2,d_1,d_2)$) exists.
artifact.status_search_result: Closed formulas in terms of weights and degrees are known for the image Milnor number of weighted-homogeneous map-germs $(\mathbb{C}^n,0)\to(\mathbb{C}^{n+1},0)$ (proved for low $n$, with extensions for $n=4,5$), and partial formulas relate the $\mathcal{A}_e$-codimension to other invariants (Milnor number of the double point curve, triple points, cross-caps). However, a general closed formula expressing the $\mathcal{A}_e$-codimension of such a corank-one weighted homogeneous germ purely in terms of the weights and degrees does not appear to be available in the literature; the question seems to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Image Milnor Number Formulas for Weighted-Homogeneous Map-Germs
status_evidence.snippet: Formulas for the image Milnor number of weighted-homogeneous map-germs in terms of weights and degrees.
status_evidence.claim: Weights-and-degrees formulas exist for $\mu_I$, the analog the question asks for $\mathcal{A}_e$-codim.

status_evidence.title: Weighted homogeneous map germs of corank one from C^3 to C^3
status_evidence.snippet: Studies $\mathcal{A}_e$-codimension of weighted homogeneous corank-one germs via auxiliary invariants.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results express $\mathcal{A}_e$-codimension in terms of double point Milnor number, triple points, and cross-caps rather than purely in terms of weights/degrees.
